title: Tired Emoji: Copy & Paste 😴 🥱 Sleepy Faces, Emoticons & Combos
meta_description: Copy and paste tired emoji like 😴 🥱 😫, typed sleepy emoticons such as |-) and -_-, and exhausted combo sets for captions and replies.
hero_tagline: From a drowsy 🥱 yawn to full 😩 burnout: every flavor of tired, plus typed sleepy emoticons and ready-made combos. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
intro: Tired means two different things: the pleasant 😴 sleepy-and-ready-for-bed kind, and the 😫 exhausted, burned-out kind where you're running on empty. This page splits them cleanly: drowsy yawns and bedtime symbols on one side, weary and melting-from-exhaustion faces on the other. Around them sit recovery-mode props like ☕ coffee and 🌙 moons, typed |-) emoticons, a few sleepy kaomoji such as (-_-)zzz, and one-click combo sets for late-night captions and "so done" replies. Grab a single face or copy a whole combo depending on how tired you actually are.
